## What's Changed

### New Features

- Added named manual allow and deny IP/CIDR lists alongside managed external blocklists.
- Added a protection dashboard with classified GEO-IP, manual-list, and external-list block metrics.
- Added a filterable and sortable Web Protection log tab with retained protection events.

### Optimizations

- Added compact GEO-IP country selection controls and IP-list previews.
- Added entry counts, update timestamps, and targeted refreshes for external blocklists.

### Bug Fixes

- Fixed large IP-list processing and Caddy rule generation for large blocklists.
- Added scrollable protection-event previews when multiple events are retained.
